title: Campaigns Dismiss State
description: `$GROK_HOME/campaigns_state.json` — on-disk record of dismissed campaign announcement ids. Read fail-open (missing/malformed file yields an empty dismissed set) via `load_dismissed_ids_from_home`; written by the shell's dismiss action using the same `CampaignsState` struct so read/write can't drift. No `rename_all` attribute on the struct, so the JSON key is the literal Rust field name `dismissed_ids` (snake_case, not camelCase). [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-config/src/loader.rs:372-399]

dismissed_ids.description: Campaign ids the user has dismissed. `#[serde(default)] Vec<String>` on `CampaignsState` — absent key deserializes to an empty vec (and a missing/unreadable file also fail-opens to an empty set at the `load_dismissed_ids_from_home` call site). [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-config/src/loader.rs:377-381,388-399]
